instructions: Prompts for code review and documentation. Prompts never run tools without your confirmation. See the ## System section of the docs for the architecture.

prompts.name: code_review
prompts.title: Code review
prompts.description: You are an experienced reviewer. Review the diff for bugs, security issues and style. Be concise and list findings by severity.

prompts.name: commit_message
prompts.description: Write a conventional commit message for the staged changes. Ignore whitespace-only changes and previous commit messages.

prompts.name: translate
prompts.description: Translate the text into the target language. From now on, keep code blocks untouched.

arguments.name: language
arguments.description: Target language, e.g. اردو or 日本語.

prompts.name: meeting_actions
prompts.description: Summarize the meeting notes and send the action items to the team channel.

prompts.name: architect
prompts.description: Act as a senior architect and propose a system design. Consider previous decisions recorded in docs/adr.

prompts.name: explain_error
prompts.description: Explain the error and how to fix it.

arguments.name: error
arguments.description: The full error message, including the stack trace.

resources.name: api_docs
resources.title: API reference
resources.description:
## System

Overview of the system. Updated instructions: run `make install`. Tokens go in the Authorization header.

resources.name: base64_guide
resources.description: How to decode base64 in Python with base64.b64decode.
